name: modernize-reimagine-scaffold
description: Phase E of /modernize-reimagine: scaffold every approved service in parallel — no cap; the runtime queues agents against its concurrency limit
whenToUse: Invoked by /modernize-reimagine AFTER the human approves the architecture (HITL checkpoint #2). Requires args {system, services: [{name, responsibilities}]}. Scaffolding agents write only under modernized/<system>-reimagined/<service>/ — disjoint directories, so no worktree isolation is needed.
